name: French White Soup
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: 1 tbsp lean raw ham, finely chopped

steps: Wipe veal, remove from bone, and cut in small pieces.
Put meat, bone, and water in kettle, heat slowly to boiling-point, skim, and cook slowly four hours.
Cook vegetables and ham in one tablespoon butter five minutes, add to soup with peppercorns and salt, and cook one hour.
Reheat three cups stock, thicken with remaining butter and flour cooked together, and just before serving add cream and egg yolks.
Garnish with one-half cup cooked green peas and Chicken Custard cut in dice.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
